# grokzilla.shop / x402-micro-pay.com

> Humanless microservices marketplace for AI agents. Pay-per-call with x402 (USDC on Base mainnet eip155:8453). Humans can also pay with Stripe.

## Identity

- Primary (canonical): https://grokzilla.shop
- Alias (same content, canonical points to primary): https://x402-micro-pay.com
- Protocol: x402 v2 exact scheme
- Network: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)
- Asset: USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
- Billing: paid only (free_beta: false)

## Critical agent endpoints (start here)

- Try first (cheapest paid call): POST https://grokzilla.shop/api/skills/uuid-mint
  Body: {"count":1,"version":4} · Price: $0.003 USDC on Base (atomic 3000) · payTo 0xc22f9CAEBAc37fE72D5142f35f21f6696Ea9Ef69
  Buyer gets: {"ok":true,"ids":["…uuid v4…"],"skill":"uuid_mint",…} for job IDs / idempotency keys
  Flow: unpaid POST → 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE retry
- Manifest: https://grokzilla.shop/.well-known/x402
- Catalog (JSON): https://grokzilla.shop/api/catalog
- OpenAPI: https://grokzilla.shop/openapi.json
- Humanless contract: https://grokzilla.shop/contracts/humanless.json
- Health: https://grokzilla.shop/health
- MCP (Streamable HTTP, JSON): https://grokzilla.shop/mcp
- MCP quickstart: https://grokzilla.shop/agents (markdown: https://grokzilla.shop/agents.md)
- MCP discovery: https://grokzilla.shop/.well-known/mcp · server card: https://grokzilla.shop/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Pricing: https://grokzilla.shop/pricing
- Terms: https://grokzilla.shop/terms
- Daily utils (first-party): POST /api/skills/json-flatten, /api/skills/text-diff, /api/skills/url-normalize, /api/skills/html-clean, /api/skills/json-schema-validate, /api/skills/keyword-extract, /api/skills/token-count, /api/skills/json-sort ($0.003), /api/skills/sha256 ($0.003), /api/skills/uuid-mint ($0.003), /api/skills/slugify ($0.003), /api/skills/pii-redact ($0.003), /api/skills/csv-normalize ($0.003), /api/skills/base64 ($0.003), /api/skills/epoch-convert ($0.003), /api/skills/url-to-markdown ($0.003), /api/skills/token-risk ($0.005), /api/skills/json-repair ($0.0041), /api/skills/cron-next ($0.0031)
- Skill endpoints are POST only: POST /api/skills/<slug> (POST only; GET returns usage and the 402 payment terms, never runs the skill)
- Data services (free public sources, not charged on empty/failed): POST /api/skills/token-price ($0.002), /api/skills/email-check ($0.0032), /api/skills/news-brief ($0.0101), /api/skills/ip-intel ($0.0033), /api/skills/llm-cost-quote ($0.0034), /api/skills/address-validate ($0.001), /api/skills/gas-price ($0.001), /api/skills/erc20-meta ($0.002), /api/skills/dns-lookup ($0.002), /api/skills/name-resolve ($0.003), /api/skills/tx-status ($0.002), /api/skills/hex-decode ($0.001), /api/skills/block-number ($0.001), /api/skills/whois-rdap ($0.003)

## How agents pay

1. GET /.well-known/x402 or /api/catalog for services + prices.
2. POST a skill endpoint. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.
3. Sign exact USDC payment to the pay_to address on Base mainnet, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
4. Receive JSON result. Respect max_spend_per_call / max_spend_per_session in humanless.json.

## MCP

Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC at https://grokzilla.shop/mcp. Quickstart: https://grokzilla.shop/agents. Guides: https://grokzilla.shop/docs/mcp. Discovery tools (`list_skills`, `get_skill`) are free. Paid tools use the same x402 prices as the HTTP routes (USDC on Base). A client that cannot attach an x402 payment receives a PaymentRequired tool result and should stop. The server does not pay and does not hold a wallet key.

## Partner resale (separate group; resold partner services)

Resold partner services (provider x402-mcp.onrender.com, not ours). GET with query params, paid per call via x402 on Base. Your payment settles first; if the partner then fails you get charged:true plus a full refund record. Output is normalized to grokzilla.partner-resale.v1. Separate from the native skills list.

| id | method | endpoint | price | query params (* required) |
|----|--------|----------|-------|---------------------------|
| base-tx-decision | GET | /api/resale/base/tx-decision | $0.020001 (20001 atomic) | gas, urgency |
| base-finality-check | GET | /api/resale/base/finality-check | $0.020002 (20002 atomic) | tx* |
| nyc-property-check | GET | /api/resale/us/nyc/property-check | $0.020003 (20003 atomic) | address* |
| mn-property-check | GET | /api/resale/mn/property-check | $0.020004 (20004 atomic) | address* |

Output: JSON, schema `grokzilla.partner-resale.v1` (envelope ok/schema/route/provider/subject/verdict/status/summary/risk_flags/evidence/sources/disclaimer/checked_at/upstream_tx + route-specific `data`). Full JSON Schemas: GET /api/catalog (partner_resale.services[].output_schema). These are not MCP tools and not in the native skills count.

## Kits (one-time download, x402)

- [Domain-to-Vercel MCP kit (bring your own keys)](https://grokzilla.shop/kits/domain-to-vercel): $5.00 USDC on Base. `POST https://grokzilla.shop/api/kits/domain-to-vercel/buy` returns a download link (expires 15 min, 3 downloads). License: [No-Resale](https://grokzilla.shop/kits/license).

## Credit pack
- POST /api/credits/buy — Credit pack: 300 calls of any skill listed at $0.005 or less, for one $1.00 x402 payment. Returns a token (shown once) for the X-Credit-Token header. Failed calls use no credit. Expires after 180 days.
- GET /api/credits/balance (header X-Credit-Token) — free balance check.

## Skill notes

- ai_detector ($0.01): trained classifier, about 78% accurate on a held-out benchmark (not a guarantee). `uncertain` results suggest a rerun on a longer section (300+ words). Tell phrases are only a secondary "possible AI influence" signal.
- seo_v2 / seo_compare / agent_ready_audit / agent_ready_kit / agent_ready_recheck: not charged when the site blocks us or is unreachable (422, score null, charged:false; payment is never settled). Agent-Ready inputs: `override_full_disallow` (bool, default false: never open a site-wide `Disallow: /` to AI bots unless true), `runs_a2a_agent` (bool, default false: agent-card.json only if true). Recheck needs `report_id` (400 before payment). Docs: https://grokzilla.shop/docs/seo-v2 and https://grokzilla.shop/docs/agent-ready
